units.behavior: Discriminate the logic-neutral FormalClaim source envelope from proof, provider, executable, discharge, and promotion state.
units.acceptance: Positive logic-neutral source validates; forbidden proof/provider/discharge fields and a second canonical proposition reject.

units.behavior: Define one environment-bound native Lean/DTT formal-language profile without replacing the FOL profile.
units.acceptance: Exact environment-bound profile validates; path-only identity, missing lock, forbidden sorry/unsafe policy, or universal-FOL/Lean collapse rejects.

units.behavior: Validate the disjoint native-Lean and accepted translated-to-Lean binding paths with explicit preservation and loss.
units.acceptance: Native identity equality and accepted translation validate; mixed paths, stale/missing acceptance, or lossy-as-exact mappings reject.

units.behavior: Admit only an explicit local category model and classify incomplete or vacuous categorical language more narrowly.
units.acceptance: Complete local structure and non-vacuity validate; missing laws becomes typed-graph-fragment and collapse fixtures cannot claim richer structure.

units.behavior: Define exact Lean provider-manifest admission inputs and nonauthority policy.
units.acceptance: Pinned runtime, inspector, toolchain, lock, source/import policies, axioms, resources, and no-network policy validate; path-only or authority-bearing manifests reject.

units.behavior: Define total Lean theorem request and receipt semantics, including unresolved and stale non-property outcomes.
units.acceptance: Exact checked and typed non-pass receipts validate; build-failure-as-false, sorry, axiom, unsafe, mismatch, stale, path-only, or ceiling-inflated checked outcomes reject.

units.behavior: Materialize and prove coverage of every one of the 22 accepted Design witness scenarios.
units.acceptance: All 22 Design witness IDs map exactly once to an executable positive or negative case and expected typed outcome; missing, duplicate, or softened cases reject.

units.behavior: Construct deterministic source-set, import-closure, environment, proposition, declaration, and type identities from exact bytes.
units.acceptance: Repeated exact inputs yield identical identities; any byte, import, option, lock, toolchain, proposition, declaration, or type drift changes identity; path-only inputs reject.

units.behavior: Run and inspect one exact local Lean build into a total theorem receipt without conflating build failure with proposition false.
units.acceptance: Locked SchemaInstance theorem fixture checks and exact receipt binds all identities; build, declaration, type, sorry, axiom, unsafe, source/import, and stale failures normalize only to allowed non-pass outcomes.

units.behavior: Join an exact Lean theorem receipt into a Lean-specific immutable EVF evidence handle at the narrowest current ceiling.
units.acceptance: Exact current identity and ceiling join succeeds; GraphLaw reuse, stale inputs, foreign evidence, authority transfer, self-discharge, or ceiling widening reject.

units.behavior: Validate an independently owned Lean model-to-runtime conformance binding without changing theorem evidence.
units.acceptance: Exact parser/serialization/adapter/runtime/fixture identities validate; theorem-only, missing boundary, stale runtime, or production-inflated claims reject while theorem receipt remains independently valid.

units.behavior: Migrate the preserved @2 candidate into a local @3 FormalClaim ontology/contract candidate without promotion or inverse-edge authority.
units.acceptance: @2 FOL meaning remains representable, @3 adds typed Lean/category/provider/conformance references, canonical edge direction is preserved, and every migrated entry remains candidate authority none.

units.behavior: Replay the complete FormalClaim-to-Lean-to-EVF path and prove cross-boundary non-inflation over exact fixtures.
units.acceptance: All contract families, 22 witnesses, existing theorem fixture, stale replay, graph-family separation, theorem/runtime separation, business correspondence, and no-discharge/no-promotion invariants pass together.

units.behavior: Prepare and validate an exact C12 pre-merge freeze package without supplying human approval or merging.
units.acceptance: Complete repository diff inventory, branch/base/head ancestry, exact-head passing validations, fixed ceiling, verification level, response binding, hardened validator, and separate merge-owner principal authentication are all represented; absent Victor response remains an explicit merge blocker.
